scores.tell: Candelabra is dead-frontal and symmetric with a flat radial background; real cards show a bit more top-face/three-quarter turn, though base ellipse gives mild height.
High-angle, wide ground plane with fence and grass is a deep scene; pool rings stacked with strong top-down view and painterly grass, more layered than real object-on-simple-background cards.
Wagon is nearly side-on with deep landscape (hills, clouds, road) in several layers; wheels perspective is mild but scene depth is far more than typical cards. Closer to the grade-2 wagon.
Phone booth has a consistent three-quarter view and floor line, but a hard horizon between floor and wall is flat, and the near-orthographic box lacks the real cards' camera height.
Wide-angle dock scene with a large water plane, strong perspective on planks and far beach; many depth layers and a deep horizon, unlike simple card staging.
none; fins seen from above at a mild consistent angle on a flat background, like the real towel.
Gloves rest on a table with a hard backdrop wall; the ground plane reads fine and the angle is mild, but the two gloves differ slightly in view.
none; flip-flops viewed from high angle, consistent, no background depth.
Boot is pure side profile, with no top face and no turn, and no ground. Flat but matches the simple-background real cards; the sole is a little too orthographic.
Broom floats diagonally on a flat pattern with consistent mild perspective; the head is slightly foreshortened, with no ground, as in the real towel card.
